24:1: This is a surah that We have sent down and made obligatory, and in it We have sent down clear verses so that perhaps you may take heed.
24:2: The fornicating woman and the fornicating man, strike each one of them with a hundred lashes. If you believe in Allah and the Last Day, let not pity for them seize you concerning the religion of Allah, and let a group of the believers witness their punishment.
24:3: The fornicating man marries only a fornicating woman or a polytheist woman. And the fornicating woman, only a fornicating man or a polytheist man marries her, and this has been made forbidden to the believers.
24:4: And to those who accuse chaste women of zina and then do not bring four witnesses, strike them with eighty stripes and never accept their testimony, and it is they who are the transgressors (fasiqun).
24:5: Except those who repent after this and make amends. Indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
24:6: And those who accuse their spouses of zina and have no witnesses other than themselves, the testimony of each one of them is four testimonies in the name of Allah that he is indeed of the truthful.
24:7: And fifthly, that the curse of Allah be upon him if he is of the liars.
24:8: And that which averts the punishment from her is that she testifies four testimonies in the name of Allah; indeed, he is of the liars.
24:9: And in the fifth, that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he is of the truthful.
24:10: If it were not for the grace of Allah upon you and His mercy, and that Allah is indeed Acceptor of repentance, All-Wise.
24:11: Indeed, those who brought forth that slander are a group from among you. Do not consider it an evil for you; on the contrary, it is a good for you. For each person among them is what he earned of sin. And for the one among them who took upon himself the greater part of it, there is a great punishment.
24:12: When you heard it, should not the believing men and believing women have thought good within themselves and said, 'This is a clear slander'?
24:13: Should they not have brought four witnesses against it? Since they did not bring the witnesses, then it is they who are the liars in the sight of Allah.
24:14: If it were not for the grace of Allah upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, a great punishment would surely have touched you because of that which you plunged into.
24:15: At that time you were taking it with your tongues and saying with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge, and you thought it light, whereas in the sight of Allah it is great.
24:16: When you heard it, should you not have said: 'It is not fitting for us to speak of this; far be it (hasha), this is a great slander'?
24:17: Allah admonishes you never to return to the like of it forever, if you are believers.
24:18: Allah makes clear to you the verses, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
24:19: Indeed, those who love that immorality should spread among those who believe, for them is a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. Allah knows, and you do not know.
24:20: If it were not for the grace of Allah upon you and His mercy, and that Allah is indeed Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.
24:21: O you who believe, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Whoever follows the footsteps of Satan, indeed he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. If it were not for the grace of Allah upon you and His mercy, not one of you would ever have been cleansed, but Allah cleanses whom He wills, and Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
24:22: Let not those of grace and abundance among you swear not to give to the relatives, the needy, and those who emigrated in the way of Allah; let them pardon and let them overlook. Would you not love that Allah should forgive you? Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
24:23: Indeed, those who slander chaste, unaware, believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter, and for them is a great punishment.
24:24: On that Day their tongues and their hands and their feet will bear witness against them regarding what they used to do.
24:25: On that Day Allah will pay them in full their deserved due, and they will know that Allah is the manifest Truth.
24:26: Corrupt women are for corrupt men, and corrupt men are for corrupt women; pure women are for pure men, and pure men are for pure women. Those are innocent of what they say. For them is forgiveness and a noble provision.
24:27: O you who believe, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you have asked permission and greeted their occupants; that is better for you, so that perhaps you may take heed.
24:28: If you do not find anyone in them, do not enter them until permission is given to you. And if it is said to you, 'Turn back,' then turn back; this is purer for you, and Allah knows what you do.
24:29: There is no blame upon you for entering uninhabited houses in which there is some utility for you. Allah knows what you reveal and what you conceal.
24:30: Say to the believing men: Let them lower their gaze and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allah is fully aware of what they do.
24:31: And say to the believing women: Let them lower their gaze, guard their chastity, and not display their adornment - except what appears of it - and let them draw their headcovers over their collars, and not display their adornment - except to their husbands, or their fathers, or their husbands' fathers, or their sons, or their husbands' sons, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or their sisters' sons, or their women, or those whom their right hands possess, or male attendants who have no sexual desire, or children who are not yet aware of women's private parts - and let them not strike their feet so that what they hide of their adornments may be known. And repent to Allah, all of you, O believers, so that you may attain salvation.
24:32: Marry off the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they are poor, Allah will enrich them from His grace. Allah is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing.
24:33: Let those who find no means to marry act chastely until Allah enriches them from His grace. And make an agreement with those who seek a written agreement from among the slaves under your hands to gain their freedom, if you see good in them. Give them from the wealth that Allah has given you. Do not compel your female slaves to prostitution to gain the temporary benefit of worldly life when they want to remain chaste. Whoever compels them, indeed Allah, after their compulsion, is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
24:34: By oath, We have sent down to you clear verses, an example from those who passed away before you, and an admonition for those who guard against evil.
24:35: Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth. The likeness of His light is like a niche in which is a lamp. The lamp is within a glass. The glass is as if it were a brilliant star. It is lit from a blessed olive tree; neither of the east nor of the west. Its oil almost gives off light even if no fire touches it. Light upon light. Allah guides whom He wills to His light. Allah sets forth likenesses for people. Allah is the Knower of all things.
24:36: In houses which Allah has permitted to be raised and in which His name is mentioned, they glorify Him in the mornings and the evenings.
24:37: Men whom neither trade nor commerce distracts from the remembrance of Allah, from establishing the salah, and from giving the zakat; they fear a Day in which hearts and eyes will be overturned.
24:38: That Allah may reward them with the best of what they did and increase for them from His bounty, and Allah provides for whom He wills without measure.
24:39: As for those who disbelieve, their deeds are like a mirage in a flat plain; the thirsty one thinks it is water, until when he comes to it he finds nothing, and he finds Allah beside him, so He settles his account in full, and Allah is swift in reckoning.
24:40: Or like darknesses in a deep sea; a wave covers it, over it a wave, over it a cloud; darknesses, some of them upon others; when he puts out his hand, he can hardly see it. And whoever Allah has not made a light for him, then for him there is no light.
24:41: Did you not see that undoubtedly whoever is in the heavens and the earth and the birds with wings spread glorify Allah? Each one knows its salah and its glorification.
24:42: The dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah, and to Allah is the return.
24:43: Did you not see that Allah drives the clouds, then brings them together, then makes them into a heap, so you see the rain emerging from between them? He sends down hail from the sky, from mountains in it, striking with it whom He wills and turning it away from whom He wills; the flash of its lightning almost takes away the sight.
24:44: Allah alternates the night and the day. Undoubtedly in this there is surely a lesson for the possessors of insight.
24:45: Allah created every living creature from water; so of them are some that walk upon their belly, some that walk upon two feet, and some that walk upon four feet. Allah creates what He wills; undoubtedly Allah is powerful over all things.
24:46: By oath, We have sent down clarifying verses. Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path.
24:47: They say: "We believed in Allah and in the Messenger, and we obeyed." Then a group of them turns away after that. And those are not the believers.
24:48: When they are called to Allah and His Messenger that he may judge between them, immediately a group of them turns away.
24:49: And if the right is on their side, they come to him obediently.
24:50: Is there a disease in their hearts, or have they doubted, or do they fear that Allah and His Messenger will be unjust to them? Rather, they are the very wrongdoers.
24:51: The word of the believers is only this: when they are called to Allah and His Messenger that he may judge between them, they say, "We heard and we obeyed."
24:52: Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, and fears Allah and is mindful of Him, then those are the very ones who attain salvation.
24:53: And they swore by Allah with the utmost strength of their oaths that if you command them, they will surely go out. Say: Do not swear.
24:54: Say: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger. If you turn away, then upon him is only what has been placed on him, and upon you is what has been placed on you. If you obey him, you will find the right way. And there is nothing upon the Messenger except clear conveyance.
24:55: Allah has promised those among you who believe and do righteous deeds that He will surely make them successors upon the earth just as He made those before them successors; and that He will surely establish for them their religion which He has approved for them and will surely exchange their fear for security. They worship Me, they associate nothing with Me. Whoever disbelieves after this, then those are the transgressors.
24:56: And establish the salah and give the zakat and obey the Prophet so that you may receive mercy.
24:57: Do not think that those who disbelieve will render (Allah) helpless on the earth; their refuge is the Fire, and what an evil destination it is!
24:58: O you who believe! Let those whom your right hands possess and those among you who have not reached puberty ask permission of you at three times: before the morning prayer, when you take off your garments at noon, and after the night prayer. (These are) three times of privacy for you. Outside of these times, there is no sin upon you nor upon them in moving about among one another. Thus Allah explains the verses to you. Allah is al-Alim, al-Hakim.
24:59: When the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission just as those before them asked permission. Thus Allah explains His verses to you. Allah is knowing, wise.
24:60: As for elderly women who do not expect to marry, there is no sin upon them in taking off their garments without displaying their adornments. That they remain modest is better for them. Allah is hearer, knower.
24:61: There is no difficulty upon the blind, no difficulty upon the lame, no difficulty upon the sick, nor upon yourselves in eating from your houses, or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your paternal uncles, or the houses of your paternal aunts, or the houses of your maternal uncles, or the houses of your maternal aunts, or the house of him whose keys you possess, or the house of your friend. There is no sin upon you in eating together or separately. When you enter houses, greet yourselves with a greeting from Allah, blessed and good. Thus Allah explains the verses to you, so that you may reason.
24:62: The believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger. And when they are with him on a collective matter, they do not go until they ask permission of him. Undoubtedly, those who ask permission of you, those are the ones who believe in Allah and His Messenger. So when they ask permission of you for some of their affairs, give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness from Allah for them. Undoubtedly Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
24:63: Do not make the call of the Messenger among you like the call of some of you to another. Allah surely knows those among you who slip away secretly. Let those who oppose His command beware of a fitnah coming upon them or suffering a painful punishment.
24:64: Pay attention, undoubtedly whatever is in the heavens and the earth is Allah's. He knows what you are upon and the Day they will be returned to Him. He will inform them of what they did. Allah is the Knower of all things.
